title: FR-331 BackendProviderEnvelope quire.backend-provider/v1
description: One envelope in three stages: the manifest stage (a plugin's hello body), the request stage (a request body) and the outcome stage (a result body). Every member names its owning requirement in its description. Readers convert from this wire into their own types (QSL ADR-013 T-7); no reader holds a copy of this schema.

CapabilityVocabulary.description: FR-331, FR-290: selects the kind vocabulary for manifest, request and results; any other value or none refuses the envelope invalid_capability/unknown-vocabulary.

ManifestStage.description: FR-331 manifest stage; FR-462 hello body.

manifest.description: FR-462, FR-305: a provider's own manifest names its one backend.

RequestStage.description: FR-331 request stage; FR-462 request body. The manifest is the registry snapshot the request's candidates are checked against (FR-290).

OutcomeStage.description: FR-331 outcome stage; FR-462 result body.

Count.description: An unsigned integer that RFC 8785 serializes exactly.

U64String.description: An unsigned 64-bit integer, 0 to 18446744073709551615, as its canonical decimal string, so RFC 8785 keeps every value exact.

Decimal.description: A non-negative decimal string: 0 or [1-9][0-9]* (FR-392 seed, FR-393 and FR-400 decimals).

Base64Url.description: FR-331, FR-462: RFC 4648 section 5 base64url with no padding and zero unused trailing bits, so one byte string has exactly one spelling.

BackendId.description: FR-290: a backend identity, unique within a registry, compared bytewise as UTF-8.

Kind.description: FR-290: the closed capability-kind vocabulary quire.capability-kind/v1.

LimitName.description: FR-461: a limit member name, such as max_states.

SettingName.description: FR-461: the dotted setting name that raises a limit, such as model_check.max_states.

Locus.description: FR-331 (defined): the source locus of an expression, named by the checked-package node and its occurrence; the package source map gives its regions.

ProvisionRef.description: FR-364, FR-368: a document held in the request's byte provision, named by its sha256-jcs digest.

ProvisionEntry.description: FR-331 (defined): one byte-provision document: its sha256-jcs digest and its bytes.

StringMap.description: A nonempty map of string values; absence means no entries.

CountMap.description: A nonempty map of counts keyed by limit name.

TypedValue.description: FR-181: the typed canonical form of a value; a unit-bearing quantity is written as a rational with its unit; the decimal form with a unit is read and normalized to it (FR-142).

TransitionIdentity.description: FR-181: a transition identity in typed canonical form; a protocol subject's protocol-transition identity is owned by FR-425.

DiagnosticCause.description: FR-272: a typed diagnostic cause: its code family, its closed variant and, keyed by FR-272 payload names, the payload the variant requires.

UndefinedReason.description: native diagnostics catalog: a catalogued undefined reason, such as absent-key.

Where.description: FR-364: the evaluation point of an undefined evaluation, with FR-364's keys; FR-408 adds test and trace_index, FR-411 initial_state, binding and product_state, FR-379 row.

UndefinedEvaluation.description: FR-364: the one undefined-evaluation envelope; it is also the FR-331 result cause undefined-evaluation{where, cause}.

Manifest.description: FR-331: one backend descriptor per registered backend.

BackendTool.description: FR-331: the code that decides a backend's results: exact UTF-8 name and version, and the content identity of the build inputs of the provider code that implements the backend.

BuildDigest.description: FR-331, FR-201: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 bytes of the build-input record of the provider code that implements a backend, computed by the build that compiles it; the FR-322 digest-record shape.

tool.description: FR-331: required on every descriptor: the code that decides the backend's results, by name and version. An external tool: the executable it invokes and the version that executable reports when the descriptor is built. A pure in-process engine: the crate that implements it and that crate's version in the producer's build. In both, build is the content identity of the provider code's build inputs, so a code change with an unchanged version changes the descriptor. Part of the manifest digest preimage and never of the backend identity.

advertises.description: FR-290: advertised (kind, mode) pairs. A hello refused here for an absent or unknown kind or mode, or for missing or unknown evidence kinds, is an FR-290 registration refusal, not an FR-462 wire failure.

domains.description: FR-331: the ADR-014 domain kinds for which the backend accepts a finite bound. FR-290 rule: on every descriptor, a present domains that is empty, holds another kind or repeats a kind is refused; an absent domains is refused only when the descriptor advertises a bounded mode, so an unbounded-only descriptor may omit it. Either refusal is the FR-290 registration refusal invalid_capability/invalid-domains.

options.description: FR-331 (defined): the backend's published option defaults (FR-196 options).

bounds.description: FR-331 (defined): the published default of each limit the backend applies, keyed by limit name (FR-461, FR-368, FR-392, FR-399).

obligation_forms.description: FR-349: the obligation forms the backend discharges.

reductions.description: FR-382: the state-space reductions the backend applies.

evidence_kinds.description: FR-290: evidence kinds of a probabilistic-satisfaction backend.

fairness_kinds.description: FR-368: fairness kinds a temporal-satisfaction backend decides.

memory_models.description: FR-331, FR-439: memory models a temporal-satisfaction backend decides for items over a subject with a weak parallel, by the names of the memory clause; absent means sc only.

Request.description: FR-331 request: contract-package items, requested claims, domains and limits.

package.description: FR-331, FR-462: the RFC 8785 bytes of the quire.checked-package/v2 document, unpadded base64url.

package_id.description: FR-331, FR-462, FR-305: the package's package_id; the reader decodes package and refuses a recomputed package_id that differs, stale_dependency/content-mismatch.

dependencies.description: FR-331 (defined): the v2 bytes of each package in the proved package's recursively derived dependency closure, including transitive-only packages, ordered by package_id digest.

provision.description: FR-364, FR-368: the byte provision; entries ordered by digest, each digest once.

deadline_ms.description: FR-462, FR-305: the provider deadline in milliseconds.

memory.description: FR-434: memory-model selections of outermost parallel controls.

RequestItem.description: FR-331 request item. kind, extent and the probabilistic evidence kind may be absent or out of vocabulary on the wire, because FR-290 settles each such item invalid-request on its own; candidates is required (FR-331-AC-4).

request_index.description: FR-331 (defined), AD-016: the item's zero-based position; dispositions, results, counterexamples, artifacts and accounting join on it.

kind.description: FR-290: the item's one required kind; absent or null settles absent-kind, any other label unknown-kind.

claim.description: FR-331 (defined): the requested claim, by its checked-package node and occurrence.

extent.description: FR-290, ADR-014 (#222): the extent and its classification; absent settles absent-extent.

backend.description: FR-290: the backend the caller names.

options.description: FR-331, FR-196: backend options for this item.

Candidates.description: FR-331, FR-290: the registry's candidate set ordered bytewise by identity, or the unknown-backend mark.

DomainKey.description: ADR-014 (#222) DomainKey: a domain inside a node's type, or a population with no maximum.

FiniteBound.description: ADR-014 (#222) FiniteBound: the three B-4 substitution kinds. QSL FR-358's variants is a harness bound, never a substitution kind.

DomainKind.description: ADR-014 (#222) section 4: the kind of an unbounded domain, as QSL's classification gives it.

ProofBound.description: ADR-014 (#222): one substituted finite bound for one domain, with the domain's kind (FR-331). Only a boundable kind takes a bound, and the bound's variant matches the kind: cardinality for a collection or population, integer-range for an integer, depth for a recursive value type.

bounds.description: the substituted bounds, empty for an item whose domains are all finite

SymmetryDeclaration.description: FR-382: SymmetryDeclaration{population, classes}; keys in FR-181 typed canonical form.

Reductions.description: FR-382: a model-check item's reduction selection.

TemporalLimits.description: FR-368 limits (max_states, max_transitions, max_automaton_states), FR-392 max_walk_steps, FR-399 max_witness_set and max_relation_tuples, FR-439 max_store_buffer and max_messages, FR-428 max_live_instances; each absent member takes the routed provider's published default.

Temporal.description: FR-331, FR-368: the temporal member of a temporal-satisfaction item over a model subject.

subject.description: FR-368, FR-361: initial-state snapshots and universes as byte-provision references, and substituted proof bounds.

fairness.description: FR-368, FR-362: the resolved fairness set, empty for deadlock-freedom.

max_depth.description: FR-368, FR-363: the bounded-search horizon; absent for an exhaustive search.

witness_samples.description: FR-392: absent takes the provider's published default; 0 turns sampling off.

seed.description: FR-392: absent takes the provider's published default.

StatisticalLimits.description: FR-408 StatisticalLimits; each absent member takes its FR-461 published default (settings statistical.<member>).

ExactProbLimits.description: FR-411 ExactProbLimits; each absent member takes its FR-461 published default (settings exact_prob.<member>).

max_witness_paths.description: FR-411, FR-413: 0 admits no path set, so the item carries no path-set evidence.

Hybrid.description: FR-331, FR-193, FR-461: the limits of a hybrid item. max_solver_steps is a count of the provider's solver steps; max_solver_time is whole seconds of wall-clock time and is outside request identity (FR-306).

Probabilistic.description: FR-331, FR-290, FR-408, FR-411: the evidence kind and the settings and limits of that kind. An absent or unknown evidence kind is admitted on the wire and settles invalid-request (FR-290).

q.description: FR-408, FR-420: the delay-draw grid exponent of a timed subject.

Disposition.description: FR-331, FR-290: one negotiation disposition per item. An unsupported disposition's diagnostic is its warning.

Artifact.description: FR-331: immutable generated bytes with kind, identity and source map; referenced by its zero-based position.

kind.description: FR-331 (defined): the artifact kind, such as kani-harness or kani-transcript.

identity.description: FR-331 (defined), FR-196: the producer's identity for the artifact, derived from the item's claim identity, unique per request_index and kind.

source_map.description: FR-331 (defined): byte ranges of the artifact and the checked-package node occurrence each one corresponds to.

delay.description: FR-181, FR-417: the delay of a timed step.

TemporalCounterexample.description: FR-364 TemporalCounterexample; FR-417 time-lock kind and final_delay; FR-379 refinement_failure.

allOf.description: FR-364: the arms are coupled. Observed arm: null initial_state and over_binding, document steps, kind formula or an undefined-evaluation envelope whose where carries no model-arm state key. Model arm: a non-null initial_state, model steps, and an envelope whose where carries no document.

RefinementFailure.description: FR-379: exactly one refinement failure kind with its members.

ProbabilisticStep.description: FR-413, FR-410: an FR-181 trace step with its drawn scheduled identity, random values and, over a timed subject, delay.

bound.description: FR-407 owns the bound and its threshold.

choice.description: FR-413: a choice, or a distribution over choices with exact rational probabilities under a fairness set.

Assignments.description: FR-331 canonical assignments, FR-197 Input arm: one typed value per parameter, keyed by the parameter's checked-package node, in parameter order.

CounterexampleEntry.description: FR-331, QSL ADR-013 O-25: names exactly one of the transcript's artifacts entry or the canonical counterexample; backend and request_index are the originating run identity.

transcript.description: the zero-based position of the transcript in artifacts

AppliedReduction.description: FR-385, FR-403: one applied reduction with its parameters and preservation row.

ReductionNames.description: FR-411: the applied reductions, empty when none applies.

ProofBasis.description: The closed proof-basis spellings: FR-363, FR-385, FR-391, FR-411, FR-418, FR-419, FR-193 and the FR-331 Kani basis.

LimitReached.description: FR-331, FR-461: the one limit-stop cause.

QueryPart.description: FR-331: QSL FR-338's QueryPart: unrolling, base or step, and for a refinement certificate's step row r (FR-468) the text step/<r> that QSL FR-338 specifies, r the zero-based row as a canonical u64 decimal.

ProofStepLocus.description: FR-331: QSL FR-314's ProofStep{part, index}, index QSL FR-314's command number.

AutomatonStateKey.description: FR-331 transport of QSL FR-338 / ADR-018 PC-3 complete RFC 8785 UTF-8 octets: [quire.automaton-state-key/v1, context, state]. Reader admission must check the owner's closed algebra, actual property context and exact canonical bytes; base64url syntax alone is not semantic admission. No index, digest or opaque residual substitute.

ProbabilityProductKey.description: FR-331 transport of QSL FR-196 / ADR-028 PR-4 complete RFC 8785 UTF-8 octets: [quire.probability-product-key/v1, model, monitor, accumulator, pending]. All components are present; actual None is null, not omission/default. Full model body, formula monitor array, accumulators including both sums, digital tail/clock data and pending schedule/draw must satisfy the owner algebra in actual context. Reader checks canonical byte equality; no model digest/index substitute.

ProbabilityProductStateLocus.description: FR-331 / FR-412: actual complete probabilistic product identity, disjoint from model-only StateLocus.

ProductStateLocus.description: FR-331: QSL FR-338's ProductState(ProductStateRef) as QSL writes it: the model state's digest record and the complete canonical automaton octets.

HyperProductStateLocus.description: FR-331, QSL FR-163, ADR-023 HC-2: state keys in variable order; HP-3 states is the universal tuple, which may be present and empty, and witness_set retains the actual sorted existential tuple/automaton-key pairs. An empty universal tuple requires automaton_state and witness_set; every supplied existential tuple then has at least two states (n=0, n+m>=2). Nonempty tuples cover other hyper forms too: the originating checked claim determines form, exact arity, required HP-3 witness_set and key applicability. Absence differs from emptiness. Automaton octets follow FR-338; actual translation/claim admission remains a reader obligation.

HyperTransitionTupleLocus.description: FR-331, QSL FR-163/FR-179/FR-120: the actual HP-1 labelled edge tuple in execution-variable binding order, never a state-only projection. The checked claim determines exact arity and operation bindings. Each result is its actual typed value or null for an operation with no result; a typed null value is distinct. No automaton key is invented.

StateLocus.description: FR-331: QSL FR-169's ModelState as QSL writes it, the model state's digest record; also FR-418's initial discrete model state. Never an FR-412 probabilistic product projection.

ModelStateDigest.description: FR-331: a model state as QSL writes it in a certificate locus (QSL qsl-replay DigestWire): the quire.simulation.state-key/v1 domain and the state's StateKey digest.

MalformedStateLocus.description: FR-331: a model state record for the malformed rule, as QSL FR-169 writes it: the digest record of the closure entry, whose domain is any FR-201 digest domain, because FR-169 rejects an entry whose digest is outside the state-key domain at that entry. Every other rule at a model state carries StateLocus.

EntryLocus.description: FR-331: QSL FR-169's Entry{index}, a state-graph certificate entry whose closure index names no closure state, written {entry} with the index as a canonical u64 decimal.

StepVerdict.description: FR-331: QSL FR-149's StepFails verdict in QSL's wire form, a check_step verdict that judges the relation: a refinement failure, an undefined evaluation or an undetermined step, tagged by kind, unsigned integers as canonical u64 decimals.

CertificateRejected.description: FR-331 certificate-rejected{rule, at}: closed structural rule/locus pairs. Actual request/claim/checker applicability and full canonical key-body admission are mandatory reader checks (AC-26/27), not established by this global shape union.

oneOf.description: QSL FR-169 Malformed at a closure entry whose digest is outside the state-key domain: the record is written with the domain it carries.
QSL FR-169 Entry{index} for a malformed state-graph entry.
QSL FR-149 SimulationStep{position, edge: None, verdict: None}, as QSL writes it with null edge and verdict, for an initial, successors, undecided-state or certificate-shape rule.
QSL FR-149 SimulationStep{position, edge, verdict: None} for post-differs.
QSL FR-149 SimulationStep{position, edge, verdict} for step-fails.
FR-418: a node, its position in the certificate's nodes.
FR-418: an edge, its position in the certificate's edges.

FR-412, FR-418: a malformed certificate member, named as its certificate names it; QSL FR-163 also owns components for absent HP-2/HP-3 structure, including empty closure, before recomputation. The originating checked claim selects the owning member vocabulary; this branch does not authorize borrowing another checker's members.

InconclusiveCause.description: Closed inconclusive causes: FR-331 table (stale-dependency included), FR-363, FR-385, FR-399, FR-401, FR-379, FR-380, FR-468, FR-428, FR-439, AD-016 (kani_vacuous_proof).

oneOf.description: FR-349: a cvc5/Z3 disagreement FR-349 settles inconclusive; primary and cross_check are each solver's result.
FR-468: hypothesis is the invariant clause's checked-package node; result is the result of its unproved item.
FR-439: limit is the request member that raises the budget.
FR-331: a replay or certificate check that recompiled another package; requested is the request's or the certificate's package_id, recompiled the recompiled one.
FR-428-AC-1: limit names max_live_instances, the member that raises the bound.

IncompleteCause.description: FR-331 incomplete causes and FR-462 timed-out.

DeclinedCause.description: FR-331 (defined): the typed refusal category of a declined Kani run (QSL ADR-013 O-16, QC-9; AD-016 kinds 3 to 5).

FailedCause.description: FR-331 (defined), FR-462, FR-305: the tool-failure cause and the wire defect that caused it; the two byte-limit defects also carry limit, the configured maximum in bytes, and value, the byte count that crossed it.

Estimate.description: FR-410 estimate: the probability, mean or ratio its decision reads, and for a quantile claim the empirical nearest-rank quantile with the threshold's unit.

SolverInconclusive.description: FR-193, FR-331: a hybrid solver result that proves nothing; trace, when present, is the solver's reported path to a possible violation, kept as unverified evidence and never replayed.

HybridTrace.description: FR-193 Hybrid trace: the start state in the declaration's first mode and each jump, by the zero-based position of the transition taken among the previous state's mode's transitions, to the state it reaches.

HybridTraceState.description: FR-193 Hybrid trace: a mode of the declaration, the enclosure of the time at which the state is reached in exact rational seconds, and one interval per continuous variable keyed by its name.

CertificateIdentity.description: FR-201: the canonical identity digest that binds a certificate to the obligation it proves.

ProbabilityCertificate.description: FR-412 ProbabilityCertificate{identity, objective, kind, values, ranking, policy, components}.

DbmBound.description: FR-418: one DBM entry: a scaled integer bound with its strictness, or infinity.

ZoneCertificate.description: FR-418 zone certificate; components, reasons and divergence carry the Buchi emptiness extension.

divergence.description: FR-418: per node, a reachable time-divergent target node.

Result.description: FR-331 result entry. basis and certification belong to proved; cause is the closed cause; diagnostic is an FR-272 typed cause.

backend.description: FR-462: the backend identity the manifest names.

certification.description: FR-331 Certification: who stands behind a proved result.

cross_check.description: FR-331, FR-349, FR-354: the SMT backend's Z3 cross-check, recorded beside certification on a proved result when it ran; verdict is the result the cross-check alone settles.

evidence.description: FR-419 recomputable closed-form evidence (its owner's shape) under basis closed-form, or the FR-393 witness arm under cause well-definedness-unchecked; absent otherwise.

counterexample.description: the zero-based position of the item's entry in counterexamples

allOf.description: FR-331, FR-349: cross_check belongs to an SMT proof (basis bounded-complete or inductive), never to a trusted plugin proof.
FR-349: a disagreeing cross-check over an uncertified proof settles inconclusive, so an uncertified proof carries verdict proved only.

Warning.description: FR-369 fairness.strong-would-exclude; FR-349 cross-check-absent; FR-439 memory.load-buffering-shape (spelling defined in FR-331).

ToolRecord.description: FR-196: the tool the run used: its name and version, target, solver, unwind and loop bounds, and command options.

AccountingRecord.description: FR-331 accounting: exactly one terminal record per item. settled_by names whether its disposition (no result entry) or its one result entry settles the item; basis and cause live in that result entry.

max_depth.description: FR-363, FR-391: the search horizon the run used.

limits.description: FR-391, FR-392, FR-408, FR-439, FR-428: the effective value of each limit the run used, defaults included.

reached.description: FR-439, FR-428: the limits the run reached.

constraint.description: FR-382, FR-385: the state constraint the run used.
